svg.title: wrangl architecture
svg.desc: A phone, a CLI and your own agents reach the wrangl controller (through Cloudflare Access for remote access). The controller launches runners on AWS EC2 (Linux today; Android emulator and macOS planned) that dial back over NATS, and works with GitHub for pull requests and reviews.
svg.text: WEB APP · HTTP API · SQLITE · NATS + JETSTREAM
WORK · RUN · ASK · NUDGE · GATE · LAND
